name: ch10_fig12_pfba_two_stage_readout
prompt: Title (top): "pFBA의 두 단계와 출력 읽기" + smaller warm-grey "Two-Stage pFBA Readout". A left-to-right two-stage flow. Stage A marker "A" title "1단계" with input "biomass 목적" and output pill "최대 성장 μ*". Stage B marker "B" title "2단계" with lock tag "μ = μ*", objective card "총 |flux| 최소화", and output "대표 flux 해". On the right show a result card with two separate rows: "성장률 → biomass flux" and "목적값 → 총 |flux|". Place one red crossed arrow between the two rows labeled "같은 값 아님". Do not depict total flux as enzyme mass or experimental resource use. Exact labels only, no caption, paragraph, logo, watermark, number, or stray text.
